anchor.quote: where $p \ge 1$ is a fixed exponent shared by all of them
Let $L$ be the number of positions, at least the number of coefficients, with $bL \ge 2n$
the remainder $e_k$ in $\{0,\dots,2^b-1\}$ is kept as the digit
Let $T = \sum_{k<L} e_k\, 2^{bk}$ be the number the digits represent
let $C$ be the carry left after position $L-1$

gaps.quote: Each computed coefficient lies strictly within $1/2$ of its true integer $w_k$.
gaps.note: The page never says what the computed coefficients are, how they are obtained, or why their error is below 1/2. The rounding result depends on this bound, and the reader cannot check it from the page.

gaps.quote: and only their real parts matter
gaps.note: The page does not say that the values have zero imaginary part or why the imaginary parts can be ignored, so the reader cannot check that rounding the real parts alone recovers the integers w_k.

gaps.quote: because the convolution evaluated at $2^b$ is the product of the two inputs
gaps.note: The page does not say that each input integer equals its radix-2^b digit polynomial evaluated at 2^b, so the identity R = sum of w_k 2^(bk) is not checkable from this page alone.
